source_title: Meet AutoAgent — The Open-Source Library That Lets an AI Engineer and Optimize Its Own Agent Harness Overnight
ingest_note: Marktechpost body did not extract cleanly via WebFetch; reconstructed from WebSearch snippets plus awesomeagents.ai and decodethefuture.org secondary coverage. Self-reported benchmark claims flagged for verification against official leaderboards.

discovered_urls.context: Kevin Gu's official AutoAgent repository (MIT license). Contains the mutable agent.py harness pattern, program.md meta-directive format, Harbor task adapter, and Docker sandbox runner. Directly forkable.
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: 10/10 — first open-source self-optimizing harness; should be catalogued under agent-harnesses/ immediately

discovered_urls.context: Stanford/MIT Meta-Harness paper (Lee, Nair, Zhang, Lee, Khattab, Finn, March 2026). Scientific backing for the '6x performance swing from harness alone' claim. Already summarized via @omarsar0 post but not yet ingested as primary article.
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: 9/10 — academic foundation of the entire meta-harness pattern; convergence proof for our harness-engineering thesis

discovered_urls.context: Official project page for the Stanford Meta-Harness paper with benchmarks, demos, and code artifact links.
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: 8/10 — companion to arxiv:2603.28052 with practical artifacts

discovered_urls.context: Stanford's open-source meta-harness implementation against TerminalBench-2. Academic predecessor to Gu's AutoAgent, runs the same optimization pattern.
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: 9/10 — reference implementation from the original research team

discovered_urls.context: Karpathy's Autoresearch — the 630-line direct architectural ancestor that AutoAgent cites as inspiration. Same three-file self-improving loop pattern applied to ML experiments instead of agent engineering.
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: 8/10 — architectural ancestor; required reading to understand AutoAgent's design lineage

discovered_urls.context: ThirdLayer (aka joindex) company page on Y Combinator W25. Kevin Gu's company, creator of AutoAgent.

SpreadsheetBench official leaderboard; used to verify/falsify Gu's 96.5% #1 claim. Official leaderboard currently shows Claude Opus 4.6 at 34.89% — discrepancy flagged by decodethefuture.org analysis.
TerminalBench 2.0 official leaderboard; used to verify Gu's 55.1% (GPT-5) and 76.4% (Opus) claims. Already referenced by our akshay_pachaar Anatomy of Harness entry.
